title: [form][select] `data-invalid` not cleared on Select and RadioGroup fields.

labels.name: component: form
labels.description: Changes related to the form component.

labels.name: has workaround
labels.description: There’s a bug, but users have a complete workaround, so no urgent fix or release is needed.

body:
# Bug report

Errors set to radioGroups and Select elements from within a Form component do not seem to clear. The fields keep `data-invalid`, even though the element itself has been changed. This means the error set from the Form component does not clear.

## Expected behavior

After setting errors on form submit, when the field is being interacted with (e.g. an option is selected in the select field), I expected the `data-invalid` tag to disappear similar to how the Field component works.

## Reproducible example

**Example 1**
Example setting form errors with Zod: https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/confident-benz-prlpnt

First, fill in all fields and click submit, the form data is logged correctly in the console.

Refresh and try again, now click submit when not filling in any field. All fields are set to `data-invalid` and a validation message is shown below each field. When editing the regular text inpput Fields, the `data-invalid` is removed from the field the moment the content of the input changes. The error is also cleared this moment.

When the select is changed, the `data-invalid` remains on the select field. The error is not cleared.

When a radio option is selected, the same happens. 

The Form won't submit, likely because there are invalid fields in the Form.

**Example 2**
Example without Zod, using setErrors in the onSubmit of a Form element to manually set errors for each field the first time the form is submitted: https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/peaceful-meitner-5hpx4j

Interacting with the regular text Fields clears the error and removes the `data-invalid`, interacting with the select does not clear the `data-invalid` or remove the error message.


## Base UI version

Latest version
